d: In this video, I explore Beijing, the capital of China, and discover its historic heart through the city’s famous 700-year-old hutongs, traditional courtyard neighborhoods, and the iconic Bell & Drum Towers. Away from the modern skyscrapers, we walk through the narrow alleys of Old Beijing, uncover fascinating history, unique cultural traditions, and hidden stories that have survived for centuries. This journey offers a glimpse into the authentic side of China’s capital that many visitors never get to experience.
